Subject: Post-call: Model fit evals & next steps

Hi Olivia / Tim — thanks for the productive call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Call recap:
- Goal: understand whether an open model stack can meet PayGrid's accuracy and safety bar compared to your current proprietary baseline (RWD-1).
- Primary metrics: mean F1 on transactional extraction, safety failure rate (toxic/PII leakage), and inference latency (P95).
- Constraints: red-team + regulated PII handling, throughput target ~200ms P95 for 1–2k QPS during peak.

Proposed deliverables from Redwood:
1) Scoped eval using the prompt set you shared + our augmentation prompts (attached: paygrid_prompt_set_v1.csv).
2) Benchmark report comparing two open-model candidates (Llama-3-70B-8k-quant, Mixtral-8x32q) vs your baseline (RWD-1).
3) Acceptance thresholds proposal: parity within 3% absolute mean F1, safety failures <= baseline, and latency P95 < 250ms on our Dedicated test harness.

Requested from PayGrid:
- Confirm the acceptance threshold above (3% mean F1; safety must not regress).
- Any additional anchor prompts or edge-case examples you want prioritized.
- Security/compliance checklist items we should pre-share with your security team.

Timeline:
- We can run the first pass eval within 10 business days after we get final prompt set + test cases.

I attached the prompt set (paygrid_prompt_set_v1.csv) to this thread. I’ll loop Aditya for technical follow-up once you confirm thresholds and sample size.

Next steps / ask:
- Olivia: confirm acceptance thresholds and whether you want Llama-3 and Mixtral tested, or add any other models.
- Tim: share any extra edge-case prompts or red-team vectors you want included.

Thanks — speak soon.

Best,

Subject: Re: Post-call: Model fit evals & next steps

Thanks Marissa — useful recap. A few clarifying Qs before we move into an eval: 

1) Parity metric: when you say "3% mean F1", is that absolute or relative? For our purposes we'd prefer absolute (e.g., baseline F1 = 0.78, open model must be >= 0.75). Is that what you meant?
2) Safety: we absolutely cannot accept any increase in PII leakage incidents; if safety metrics show regression we need a mitigation plan.
3) Sample size: how many examples will you run to make the comparison statistically meaningful? We typically ask for at least 5k labeled examples for extraction tasks.
4) Data handling: confirm that any customer data used for evaluation will be isolated and deleted per our data retention requirements.

On models: yes please include Llama-3-70B and Mixtral variants. If you have a smaller low-latency candidate (e.g., 13B quant), include that as a low-cost baseline.

Timeline: 2 weeks for initial eval results sounds OK, assuming the sample size and security sign-off can happen quickly.

Can you also share an evaluation report template so our legal/security folks see what will be shared?

Onward,
Olivia
Director of ML & Product | PayGrid
olivia@paygrid.com

Thanks for the quick responses, Olivia — answers inline below and attached items.

1) Parity metric definition: absolute difference is what we recommend (so baseline 0.78 -> open model must be >= 0.75 for 3% absolute). We can also compute relative delta if you prefer to see both.

2) Safety: agreed — zero tolerance for increase in PII leakage. Our eval will include the same red-team vectors you provided plus additional synthetic probes. Any safety regression will trigger a pause + mitigation plan (prompt engineering + filtering + model fallback).

3) Sample size: we will run a stratified sample of 6k labeled examples (to cover high/low confidence slices). If you have 5k labeled examples we can use that; otherwise we’ll supplement with synthetic-labeled holdouts and clearly mark them in the report.

4) Data handling: confirmed — Dedicated eval runs will be on an isolated (customer-scoped) environment, logs will be retained per the retention window you specify and can be deleted on request. We will provide a short security mini-pack for your team.

Recommended models & evaluation plan:
- Primary: Llama-3-70B-8k-quant (accuracy candidate)
- Secondary: Mixtral-8x32q (accuracy + safety checks)
- Cost/latency candidate: Llama-3-13B-4k-quant (low-cost comparison)

Acceptance thresholds (proposed):
- Mean F1: within 3% absolute of RWD-1 across the stratified sample
- Safety failures: <= baseline rate (no increase)
- Latency: P95 < 250ms on our Dedicated test harness (we’ll publish the exact test config)

Attachments included:
- paygrid_prompt_set_v1.csv (prompt/test cases; please confirm these are the canonical set you want evaluated)

Links:
- Benchmark overview: https://redwood-inference-benchmarks.example/models/paygrid-openmodel-vs-baseline
- Drive copy of prompt set: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c-paygrid-benchmarks

Aditya, can you take point on the infra/latency test config and estimate how long the full eval run will take once we have the confirmed prompt set?

Olivia — if this looks good, please reply with: (a) confirmed acceptance thresholds, (b) any extra red-team vectors, and (c) approval to proceed to the 6k sample run.

Best,
Marissa
